verdict.rationale: Texas SOS publishes that SOSPortal, its online filing, ordering and search platform, adds "enhanced security through multi-factor authentication." The portal is account-based and available 24/7, which suggests a remote credential-plus-MFA sign-in rather than an in-person visit. However, the published pages never name the MFA factors or rule out biometric liveness or mailed PINs, so the core of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented MFA factor types (e.g., TOTP/SMS/email), an explicit statement that no biometric, in-person or postal-PIN step is required, and hands-on or independent confirmation of the sign-in flow.
